title: 機械系製図Ⅱ
subtitle: Mechanical Drawing II
keywords: JIS standards and mechanical drawings 2.Mechanical design 3.Manufacturing methods and accuracy/tolerance 4.CAD 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Machine drafting represents a machine with the shape and features imagined by the designer in a drawing that conforms to standards, and at the same time has the role of transmitting the design to a third party through the drawing. In this course, you will learn how to design parts based on the accepted standards of mechanical drafting. You will also learn how to specify tolerances, and how to translate the three-dimensional shape of parts to two-dimensional drawings.
advice: In this lecture, you will learn the JIS standards that are the basis of mechanical drafting and you will learn drafting methods related to accuracy and tolerance through a combination of lectures and exercises. In each class there will be a lecture during the first half and exercises during the second half, but the drafting of the assignments that are given does not end with the exercise time during the lecture. Review is necessary. As a prerequisite, you must know the handwritten drawing preparation procedure taught in "Mechanical Drawing I". It is necessary to thoroughly review the basic operation methods of computer aided design (CAD) from “Mechanical drawing I” before taking this lecture. The contents handled in this lecture are as follows. ・ Outline of JIS standards for drawing creation and CAD operation methods specialized for mechanical drawing ・ Relationship between dimensional tolerance and geometric tolerance ・ Surface roughness ・ Dimension filling method ・ Bolts and nuts ・ Keys and keyways ・ Cross sections ・ Gear basics and design machine elements such as bearings ・ Drawing mechanical parts and assembly drawings with gear pumps and flanged fixed shaft joints In addition, it is necessary to be able to fully understand the design at the actual manufacturing site.  Copying in drafting drawings is against the ethics of engineers, and credits for this subject are revoked when it is found.
books: Textbooks: New JIS mechanical drawing (6th edition), Moritika Publishing (in Japanese) JIS mechanical drawing operation method using Siemens NX, Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese) Reference books: Unspecified Reserved books: Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: (1) You can draw on the CAD software drawing creation screen. Your ability should be at a level where it is easy to create a model of the text “Mechanical Drawing”. Basically, items that should have been learned in Mechanical Drawing I (functions written in the text, drawing methods) are not taught in this course. (2) 3D (3D objects) can be modeled using 3D drafting, the 3rd angle method (2D drafting) and using two-dimensional drafting (plan view, front view, side view). (3) You have mastered the method of downloading materials and uploading reports using the student portal.

activityGoals.body: Be able to transmit a design using mechanical drawing.
Be able to draw a two-dimensional mechanical drawing from a bird's-eye view or a photograph of the machine parts
Be able to imagine the shape of a part drawn from a two-dimensional mechanical drawing created by a third party.
Be able to indicate the machine design, tolerance, and accuracy for the manufacturing method of machine parts.
Be able to prepare and explain the results of preparation and review as works at the specified time.
Be able to explain the design process and role at the manufacturing site.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) 2D drawings can be drawn with CAD software and by hand, and explain them to third parties. (2) Can recognize outlines, hidden lines, etc., necessary for developing a bird's-eye view of shafts and gears into a two-dimensional drawing. (3) 3D-draftings can be drawn and explained from a two-dimensional drawing. (4) With reference to the text JIS Mechanical Drawing, the correct shape can be drawn. (5) Can self-administer a report within a specified period and explain it to a third party. (6) Can understand and explain the relationship between manufacturing and design at a manufacturing site.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) 2D drawings can be drawn with CAD software and by hand. (2) Can recognize outlines, hidden lines, etc. and express the shape in the drawing. (3) Can draw a bird's-eye view from a 2D drawing (4) With reference to the text JIS Mechanical Drawings, under given conditions and can draw the shapes. (5) Self-management can be performed by creating a report within a specified time limit. (6) Can understand the relationship between manufacturing and design at a manufacturing site.
